lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: maalee gauRaa mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Maalee Gauraa, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh sidh saadhik mun janaa man bhaavanee har dhiaaio ||
lines.translation: All the Siddhas, seekers and silent sages, with their minds full of love, meditate on the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪਰੰਪਰੋ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਲਖਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: apara(n)paro paarabraham suaamee har alakh guroo lakhaaio ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Supreme Lord God, my Lord and Master, is limitless; the Guru has inspired me to know the unknowable Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਨੀਚ ਮਧਿਮ ਕਰਮ ਕੀਏ ਨਹੀ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham neech madhim karam keee nahee chetio har raaio ||
lines.translation: I am low, and I commit evil actions; I have not remembered my Sovereign Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਨਿ ਮੇਲਿਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਖਿਨੁ ਬੰਧ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har aan melio satiguroo khin ba(n)dh mukat karaaio ||1||
lines.translation: The Lord has led me to meet the True Guru; in an instant, He liberated me from bondage. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮਸਤਕੇ ਧੁਰਿ ਲੀਖਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh masatake dhur leekhiaa guramatee har liv laaio ||
lines.translation: Such is the destiny God wrote on my forehead; following the Guru's Teachings, I enshrine love for the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ ਦਰਗਹ ਬਾਜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch sabad daragah baajiaa har milio ma(n)gal gaaio ||2||
lines.translation: The Panch Shabad, the five primal sounds, vibrate and resound in the Court of the Lord; meeting the Lord, I sing the songs of joy. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਰਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਭਾਗੀਆਂ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: patit paavan naam narahar ma(n)dabhaageeaa(n) nahee bhaaio ||
lines.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Purifier of sinners; the unfortunate wretches do not like this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨੀ ਗਾਲੀਅਹਿ ਜਿਉ ਲੋਨੁ ਜਲਹਿ ਗਲਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: te garabh jonee gaaleeahi jiu lon jalahi galaaio ||3||
lines.translation: They rot away in the womb of reincarnation; they fall apart like salt in water. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਮਨੁ ਮੈ ਲਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: mat dehi har prabh agam thaakur gur charan man mai laaio ||
lines.translation: Please bless me with such understanding, O Inaccessible Lord God, my Lord and Master, that my mind may remain attached to the Guru's feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੈ ਰਹਉ ਲਾਗੋ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਓ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: har raam naamai rahau laago jan naanak naam samaaio ||4||3||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak remains attached to the Name of the Lord; he is merged in the Naam. ||4||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: maalee gauRaa mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Maalee Gauraa, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਸਿ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: meraa man raam naam ras laagaa ||
lines.translation: My mind is addicted to the juice of the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਭਇਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kamal pragaas bhaiaa gur paaiaa har japio bhram bhau bhaagaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: My heart-lotus has blossomed forth, and I have found the Guru. Meditating on the Lord, my doubts and fears have run away. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਲਾਗੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਹੀਅਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਸੋਇਓ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhai bhaai bhagat laago meraa heearaa man soio guramat jaagaa ||
lines.translation: In the Fear of God, my heart is committed in loving devotion to Him; following the Guru's Teachings, my sleeping mind has awakened.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਖੀਨ ਭਏ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਵਡਭਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kilabikh kheen bhae saa(n)t aaee har ur dhaario vadabhaagaa ||1||
lines.translation: All my sins have been erased, and I have found peace and tranquility; I have enshrined the Lord within my heart, by great good fortune. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭੁ ਹੈ ਕਚੂਆ ਜਿਉ ਕੁਸਮ ਚਾਰਿ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh ra(n)g kasu(n)bh hai kachooaa jiu kusam chaar din chaagaa ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukh is like the false color of the safflower, which fades away; its color lasts for only a few days.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਪਰਤਾਪੈ ਡੰਡੁ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕਾ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: khin mahi binas jaai parataapai da(n)d dharam raai kaa laagaa ||2||
lines.translation: He perishes in an instant; he is tormented, and punished by the Righteous Judge of Dharma. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਅਤਿ ਗੂੜੀ ਜਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠ ਬਹੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: satasa(n)gat preet saadh at gooRee jiu ra(n)g majeeth bahu laagaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord's Love, found in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, is absolutely permanent, and colorfast.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾਪਰੁ ਚੀਰ ਬਹੁ ਫਾਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਲਹੈ ਸਭਾਗਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa kaapar cheer bahu phaare har ra(n)g na lahai sabhaagaa ||3||
lines.translation: The cloth of the body may be torn to shreds, but still, this beautiful color of the Lord's Love does not fade away. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਾਰ੍ਹਿਓ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੈ ਰਾਂਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har chaarhio ra(n)g milai gur sobhaa har ra(n)g chaloolai raa(n)gaa ||
lines.translation: Meeting with the Blessed Guru, one is dyed in the color of the Lord's Love, imbued with this deep crimson color.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਰੈ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨੀ ਜਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak tin ke charan pakhaarai jo har charanee jan laagaa ||4||4||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak washes the feet of that humble being, who is attached to the feet of the Lord. ||4||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: maalee gauRaa mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Maalee Gauraa, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਭਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਪਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man bhaj har har naam gupaalaa ||
lines.translation: O my mind, meditate, vibrate upon the Name of the Lord, the Lord of the World, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਲੀਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੈ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: meraa man tan leen bhaiaa raam naamai mat guramat raam rasaalaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: My mind and body are merged in the Lord's Name, and through the Guru's Teachings, my intellect is imbued with the Lord, the source of nectar. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਮਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramat naam dhiaaeeai har har man japeeai har japamaalaa ||
lines.translation: Follow the Guru's Teachings, and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. Chant, and meditate, on the beads of the mala of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੀਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਬਨਮਾਲਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jinh kai masatak leekhiaa har miliaa har banamaalaa ||1||
lines.translation: Those who have such destiny inscribed upon their foreheads, meet with the Lord, adorned with garlands of flowers. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਚੂਕੇ ਸਰਬ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinh har naam dhiaaiaa tinh chooke sarab ja(n)jaalaa ||
lines.translation: Those who meditate on the Name of the Lord - all their entanglements are ended.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tinh jam neR na aavaee gur raakhe har rakhavaalaa ||2||
lines.translation: The Messenger of Death does not even approach them; the Guru, the Savior Lord, saves them. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੂ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham baarik kichhoo na jaanahoo har maat pitaa pratipaalaa ||
lines.translation: I am a child; I know nothing at all. The Lord cherishes me, as my mother and father.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਤ ਮੇਲਤੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kar maaiaa agan nit melate gur raakhe deen daiaalaa ||3||
lines.translation: I continually put my hands into the fire of Maya, but the Guru saves me; He is merciful to the meek. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਮੈਲੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਇਆ ਸਭ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਹਰਿ ਜਸਿ ਜਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bahu maile niramal hoiaa sabh kilabikh har jas jaalaa ||
lines.translation: I was filthy, but I have become immaculate. Singing the Lord's Praises, all sins have been burnt to ashes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: man anad bhaiaa gur paaiaa jan naanak sabad nihaalaa ||4||5||
lines.translation: My mind is in esctasy, having found the Guru; servant Nanak is enraptured through the Word of the Shabad. ||4||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: maalee gauRaa mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Maalee Gauraa, Fourth Mehl:
